title: Praveen Kumar Singh
text:
№ — the one behind the lens
    

    
      About
      Praveen Kumar Singh
      Photographer & Atmospheric Science Researcher
      
      Based in — Paris

      
      
        By profession, I am an atmospheric scientist who studies the air, the weather, and how they shape the places we live in. Photography grew out of the same curiosity. I am drawn to the moments when the atmosphere changes a place, such as mist over a field at dusk, rain on a city pavement, or the blue hour when a monument lights up before the sky has gone dark.
      
      
        Most of these photographs were made patiently, on foot, and in available light, in Paris, where I live, and on journeys through India and Nepal. Whether the subject is a monument, a passer-by, or a butterfly, I am looking for the same thing: the instant when light, weather, and life line up.
      
      
        Selected photographs are available as signed, limited-edition prints with a certificate of authenticity. I also take on commissions and license images for editorial and commercial use. Get in touch to talk about a print, an idea, or a collaboration.
